logp.method_description: The lipophilicity was measured in a 1-octanol/buffer system using the shake-flask method. (15) Solutions of BPP (50, 100, 150, and 200 μM) were prepared in the phosphate buffer (10 mM, pH 7.4) presaturated with 1-octanol. Equal volumes (2.0 mL) of the solution and 1-octanol presaturated with the phosphate buffer were mixed and placed in a thermostatic (25.0 ± 0.1 °C) air-bath orbital shaker at 200 rpm for 4 h. The samples were separated into two phases after centrifugation at 2500 rpm for 15 min. The concentration of the solute in the aqueous phase was determined by spectrophotometry (λmax = 267 nm). According to the law of mass conservation, the drug concentration of the corresponding 1-octanol phase and the lipo–hydro partition coefficient Po/w (Po/w = Co/Cw = Ao/Aw, where A stands for absorbance) were calculated.
